subject: Setting up multiple conditions in annotation file

messages.author: 69d5709565287188
messages.subject: Setting up multiple conditions in annotation file
parts:
Hi,

My name is Roneldine and I use MSstats to analyze DIA datasets generated with Spectronaut. Most of my studies include different conditions (for example, looking at different heart regions in male and female). Currently, I set up my analysis to compare heart regions but I would like to also include male and female as another condition.

Is that possible with MSstats? If so, do I need to set up the annotation file differently? 
I have attached a screenshot of my current setup. For example, D1,D2,D3 are male patients and D4,D5,D6 are female patients. For each patient, I am comparing left and right ventricle. I also have 2 technical replicates for each sample.

Thank you for your help,
Roneldine Mesidor

messages.author: 326c989825423bfd
messages.subject: Re: Setting up multiple conditions in annotation file
parts:
Hi,

Comparing different heart regions & male/female conditions should be possible.  With your example, you can define your conditions as RV_Male, RV_Female, LV_Male, LV_Female in the annotation file.   

With this setup, you should be able to do specific group comparisons easily, e.g. RV_Male vs RV_Female.  In order to do group comparisons between whole groups (i.e. RV vs LV), you can refer to this post which outlines how that would be performed.

Thanks,
Tony
